headline: Aligned bag tab icons and corrected keyring display and ordering on Classic and Forever.

entries.title: Aligned bag tab rail icons
entries.details: Icons on bag and bank tabs now align in a neat column instead of shifting with the length of each tab name.

entries.title: Cleaned up keyring slots and bag order
entries.details: Keyrings now only display their available slots instead of rows of locked padlocks. In views sorted by slot, the keyring now appears after your bags rather than before the backpack.
